resources.string: Check each earbud separately and combine simultaneous warnings.
Only check fresh case reports. Offline case battery cannot be monitored.

One reminder at the chosen threshold and another at 10%; choosing 10% combines them into one. Reminders rearm after a fresh reading recovers at least 5 percentage points above the corresponding threshold. Charging and pending readings do not trigger alerts. Reconnecting or restarting does not reset reminders. No speech, media interruption or extra persistent notification.
Very low battery: %1$s. Please charge soon.
